exposure: Primary emergency full dilation caesarean section
outcome: Composite of immediate perinatal adverse outcomes
cohort: Women with singleton, non-anomalous, pregnancies undergoing instrumental delivery trial in obstetric theatre.
finding: Attempting instrumental delivery in delivery suite theatre, as an alternative to primary emergency full dilation caesarean section, is both reasonable and safe.
mod_finding: Ventouse delivery performed poorly in comparison with other modes of instrumental delivery.
